Blocks.Description: A powerful shotgun specialized in removing anything it is aimed at, granted that the target is big enough.
Blocks.name: GEAR_The_MF_HOLEPUNCHER!!!!

Blocks.Description: Features two unique firing modes. Acts like a Bullpup unscoped, but unleashes a single powerful shot while scoped in
Blocks.name: Hotswap

Blocks.Description: An experimental weapon firing causatic rounds. Causes any target hit to take damage over time and reduces their armor. The bullets deal very low damage, but have great stagger potental.
Blocks.name: Viper

Blocks.Description: A unique explosive launcher which lobs high explosives. Great for area control, but beware of friendly fire.
Blocks.name: RPG

Blocks.Description: Regains a small amount of health every time a shot hits, allowing the user to survive impossible situations. Can penetrate enemies to gain even more health
Blocks.name: GEAR_Sawed-Off_Shotgun_Semi

Blocks.Description: The low damage of this gun is offset by its high fire rate, great stagger potential, and ability to apply a hindering C-Foam to enemies making it an optimal choice in crowd control.
Blocks.name: GEAR_Pistol_Auto_Staggering_HEL

Blocks.Description: A powerful precision rifle capable of devistating targets from range using explosions and shrapnel.
Blocks.name: GEAR_Pistol_Auto_Staggering_HEL

Blocks.Description: An automatic pistol-rifle hybrid firing hollow point rounds to decimate its targets.
Blocks.name: GEAR_Rifle_Semi

Blocks.Description: Specializes in bloodshed. Whether or not that is your's or your enemy's is up to you. Drains health while firing, but restores health on kill.
Blocks.name: GEAR_MachineGun_Auto_LowRPM

Blocks.Description: A unique pistol equiped with a powerful silencer and high precision multiplier. Sleepers won't hear this gun.
Blocks.name: WhisperPistol

Blocks.Description: A special 8 round revolver which fires off compressed air shots. Automatically reloads over time without the need for ammopacks.
Blocks.name: AutoloaderRevo

Blocks.Description: A extremely powerful machine gun featuring a 350 round firing capacity requiring precise control. Fire Rate increases as you keep firing, but so does recoil.
Blocks.name: The Wall

Blocks.Description: Every hit made with this gun boosts its damage by a small amount, lasting for the whole expedition. An inbuilt noise suppressor helps prevent long-range wakeups, but may still wake enemies at close ranges.
Blocks.name: GEAR_Rifle_Semi

Blocks.Description: A highly accurate shotgun which shreds enemy armor and debuffs them to take more damage. Also deals greatly increased tumor damage, allowing it to shred bosses.
Blocks.name: GEAR_Shotgun_Slug_Semi

Blocks.Description: A supportive pistol which deals no damage but can heal and disinfect the user or their teammates in a pinch. Cannot revive downed teammates. (Hit teammates to heal them, hit nothing to heal self.)
Blocks.name: GEAR_Pistol_Semi_v2

Blocks.Description: A flamethrower which can leave residual flames on the ground. Anybody hit by this weapon or the flames will suffer devastating burns.
Blocks.name: GEAR_MachineGun_Auto_LowRPM

Blocks.Description: A chain lightning shotgun which fires additional salvos off of hitting enemies. Deals significant stagger with a repeating shock.
Blocks.name: GEAR_Shotgun_Slug_Semi

Blocks.Description: A special machine gun forged from the remains of the Kraken. Fires unique homing shots which overpenetrate enemies and recharge over time.
Blocks.name: Kraken

Blocks.Description: After landing enough shots against enemies, enter the Dreadwalker state, gaining significant damage, fire rate, movement speed, and a powerful lifesteal effect for a short duration.
Blocks.name: Nightfall

Blocks.Description: A revolver imbued with an explosive debuffing effect. Hitting an enemy with this gun will apply the Unstable state causing them to explode into fire upon death.
Blocks.name: GEAR_Revolver_Semi_v2

Blocks.Description: A shotgun which deals more damage the lower health you have. Taking a hit will cause the next shot to heal, granted that it hits an enemy.
Blocks.name: GEAR_Revolver_Semi_v2
